overview: A single-page Department of State list-of-papers sheet for the subject “Manufacture of Textiles in Japan.” It indexes a telegram associated with Harrison in Switzerland concerning a report—apparently from a Japanese organization—on changes in Japan’s textile industry following the outbreak of hostilities with China; the date and recipient fields are too corrupted by OCR to identify reliably.

people.name: Harrison
people.role: Individual associated with the indexed telegram from Switzerland; position not stated

subfiles.title: List-of-papers entry concerning changes in the Japanese textile industry
subfiles.about: The sheet indexes a telegram about a report describing changes in Japan’s textile industry after hostilities with China began.
subfiles.summary: This Department of State filing sheet lists a paper under the subject “Manufacture of Textiles in Japan.” The indexed item is a telegram associated with Harrison in Switzerland and concerns a report on changes in the Japanese textile industry after the outbreak of hostilities with China. The OCR does not preserve the date or recipient legibly, and the referenced telegram itself is not present on this page.

interest: Although only an index sheet survives here, it points to contemporary reporting on how war with China altered Japanese textile production. It is useful for tracing a potentially missing or separately filed telegram and for reconstructing State Department information flows through Switzerland. The corrupted date and recipient fields also illustrate the limits of OCR for compact archival filing forms.
